question: By how much is 65% of 75 greater than (3)/(5) of 35?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Value 1 = 65% of 75 = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

Value 2 = 3/5 of 35 = 3 × 7 = 21

Difference = 48.75 − 21 = 27.75

**∴ The correct answer is 27.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** First part = **65% of 75**, Second part = **3/5 of 35**.

**Formula Used:** Percentage Value = (Percentage/100) × Total; Fraction Value = Fraction × Total.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7da93cc9542787a49f25102dc3d2c0a7e593ec8937d199ee2a5b273c1a68f59.png] 

⇒ Calculation of first part: (65/100) × 75

⇒ 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

⇒ Calculation of second part: (3/5) × 35

⇒ 3 × 7 = 21

⇒ Required difference: 48.75 − 21

⇒ Result = 27.75

**∴ The correct answer is 27.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a percentage to a fraction, divide the percentage value by 100. Example: 65% = 65/100 = 13/20.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

To convert a fraction to a percentage, multiply the fraction by 100. Example: 3/5 = (3/5) × 100 = 60%.

Base Change Property

x% of y is always equal to y% of x. This helps in simplifying calculations like 65% of 75 = 75% of 65.</p
